PTZ acceptance budgets per MOT profile, checked against tests/data/ptz/reprojection_golden.json by test_positioning_hardware_golden.py. Re-measure and review these values when the camera, firmware, calibration or Positioning configuration changes.

controller-enforce.description: Scene Controller in PTZ enforce mode consuming Positioning PoseContexts (Controller MOT). The Tracker profile is added when Tracker PTZ consumption is implemented.

ground_plane_error_m.source: Deployment decision: tracked-object spatial error limit 0.25 m.

reprojection_px.source: Derived from the held-out measurement (p95 14.9 px, max 18.4 px at 2688x1512) with about 35% headroom; the static home calibration alone measures p95 14.7 px.

pose_latency_s.source: Derived from the measurement (sample to MQTT receipt p95 26 ms, max 52 ms) with headroom for broker load; well inside max_pose_age_s 0.5.

post_motion_availability_s.source: Deployment decision: valid pose within 1 s of the mechanical stop. Measured p95 0.69 s, max 0.71 s (settle_interval_s 0.6).

valid_poses_sampled_during_motion.source: Safety: no PoseContext sampled while the head moves may be valid.

repeatability.source: The same commanded stop must resolve to the same pose across repetitions.
